mapper.sql: public_holidays.id AS id, public_holidays.name AS name, public_holidays.date_from AS dateFrom, public_holidays.date_to AS dateTo, public_holidays.created AS created, user1.username AS createdBy, public_holidays.modified AS modified, user2.username AS modifiedBy
FROM public_holidays LEFT JOIN users AS user1 ON public_holidays.created_by = user1.id LEFT JOIN users AS user2 ON public_holidays.modified_by = user2.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public_holidays ( name, date_from, date_to, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{publicHoliday.name}, #{publicHoliday.dateFrom}, #{publicHoliday.dateTo}, NOW(), #{publicHoliday.createdBy}, 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE public_holidays SET name = #{publicHoliday.name}, date_from = #{publicHoliday.dateFrom}, date_to = #{publicHoliday.dateTo}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{publicHoliday.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{publicHoliday.id}
